About Black Forest Labs
We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We’re creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we're just getting started.
Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity.
Why This Role
We're seeking a bilingual Management Accountant to serve as the cornerstone of our German accounting operations. This role combines hands-on accounting execution with strategic financial operations, ensuring seamless coordination between our German and US entities while maintaining compliance with both German and US GAAP standards.
You'll work at the intersection of day-to-day financial operations and cross-border business requirements, partnering closely with our Head of Finance, People Operations, external payroll providers, and local German accounting advisors to maintain accurate, timely financial reporting across our dual-entity structure.
What You’ll Work On
Core Accounting Operations
Manage full-cycle billing, collections, and accounts payable for German entity
Execute treasury and cash management functions, including inter-company settlements
Process and reconcile inter-company transactions between German and US entities
Partner with People Operations and external payroll agencies across Europe to ensure accurate and timely payroll accounting entries
Review payroll outputs from external providers and post journal entries to the general ledger
Reconcile payroll-related balance sheet accounts (accruals, statutory deductions, benefits) each month
Maintain accurate books and records in accordance with German GAAP (HGB)
Maintain dual bookkeeping across DATEV (German statutory books) and Rillet (global ERP), ensuring both systems remain accurate, aligned, and reconciled on an ongoing basis
Tax & Compliance
Coordinate with external German accountants (Steuerberater) to ensure accurate VAT returns and filings
Support annual tax compliance including Körperschaftsteuer and Gewerbesteuer

Help maintain documentation for US GAAP accounting policies and procedures
Process & Systems
Implement and improve accounting processes and internal controls
Work with ERP and financial systems to enhance efficiency and accuracy
Support integration of German operations into global financial infrastructure
Maintain organized documentation for internal and external stakeholders

Education : Completed Ausbildung as Steuerfachangestellter/ Steuerfachwirt or similar accounting qualification; Bachelor's degree in Finance/Accounting preferred
Experience : 3 plus years experience in accounting role(s), preferably in fast-growing companies or startups

Technical : Strong proficiency with accounting software and Excel; experience with ERP systems
Location : Based in or willing to relocate to Freiburg, Germany

s.h: While not required, it’s an added plus if you also have
s.t:
Experience with DATEV and/or modern cloud ERP systems (e.g., Rillet, NetSuite)
Familiarity with both German GAAP (HGB) and US GAAP principles
Experience working in dual-entity or international company structures
Prior work with German Steuerberater and understanding of VAT compliance
Experience coordinating with People Operations and third-party payroll providers (rather than running payroll directly)
Experience in technology or SaaS companies

How We Work Together
We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. Depending on your role, you’ll either join us in Freiburg or SF at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week), or work remotely with a monthly in-person week to stay connected. We’ll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. We think in-person time matters, and we’ve structured things to make it accessible to all. We’ll discuss what this will look like for the role during our interview process.

## Job Description ##
Join the Finance Department as a Financial Accountant, reporting to the Accounting Team Lead, and help us maintain the highest standards of financial accuracy, compliance, and reporting excellence.
In this role, you will work in a fast-paced environment, managing a wide variety of accounting and financial reporting activities. You will use analytical skills in your day-to-day work, provide timely and accurate financial information to support decision-making, and proactively identify opportunities to improve processes and controls.
More broadly, your role will be to ensure that all business transactions and events relevant to the company's financial position are recorded accurately, comprehensively, and systematically. Together with your team, you will ensure compliance with applicable accounting principles, regulatory requirements, policies, and standards.
You will contribute to providing internal and external stakeholders with a clear and reliable view of the company's financial position and performance. As a Financial Accountant, you will also support senior management with financial planning, analysis, and reporting.

* Maintain general ledger, prepare journal entries and produce various accounting schedules/reconciliation in accordance with various GAAPSs either for the bank in Switzerland (IFRS and ARB-FINMA) or for one of the foreign subsidiaries (local GAAP).
* Prepare and review monthly, quarterly and annual financial closings. Actively participate in the half-year and year-end closing, with responsibility for specific topics and notes to the financial statements. This includes preparation of answers to external auditors.
* Investigate and resolve accounting discrepancies, unusual movements and ageing items.
* Review journal entries, accruals, provisions, prepayments and other accounting adjustments.
* Ensure appropriate accounting treatment for banking transactions and financial instruments.
* Support the preparation of statutory and management financial statements.
* Contribute to the preparation of consolidated financial reporting where applicable.
* Take responsibility in accounting projects as assigned by Management,
* Provide accounting guidance and implement appropriate solutions for complex accounting issues and queries raised by various departments and foreign group entities
* Prepare miscellaneous regulatory filings (for the SNB or FINMA as example) as assigned.

* Bachelor-s degree or equivalent diploma in accounting, finance or economics.
* Minimum 5 years- experience in a similar role ideally in the banking industry.
* You must be fluent in French and English (oral and written).
* You are adaptable and experienced in managing complex financial matters within a dynamic environment.
* You are meticulous, able to collaborate cross functionally and to work on several subjects in parallel, attentive to details with very good organisation skills.
* Strong understanding of the banking business, with the ability to see the bigger picture and understand the broader financial context.
* You have experience with IFRS and generally accepted accounting principles in Switzerland (Accounting Rules for Banks -ARB-FINMA- is a plus).
* Your skills in MS Office (Excel in particular) are excellent. Knowledge of PowerBI, SQL and/or Python are a plus.
* Knowledge of software Temenos T24 and OneStream is considered a plus.

Experience resolving complex accounting issues with a broad and significant impact.

Experience navigating financial and accounting interdependencies to resolve complex financial issues, to include: understanding organizational responsibilities and enhancing working relationships; leveraging financial systems and processes that cross organizational boundaries to resolve accounting issues and produce actionable and reliable financial information; applying change management skills to drive financial improvement; effectively advocating for financial interests of a large organization.

Experience applying quantitative analytical skills to monitor and improve financial outcomes across a large organization. In addition to specialized experience, this position also has an Individual Occupational Requirement: Degree: accounting; or a degree in a related field such as business administration, finance, or public administration that included or was supplemented by 24 semester hours in accounting.

Similarly, "accountant" should be interpreted, generally, as "accountant and/or auditor.") MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS: A qualified candidate's online application and resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade level [GS-12] in the Federal service.
